about: Style and tries rules (docs/PLAN.md decision 7). Run by sva_core (packages/sva_core/test/ascents/ascent_rules_test.dart) and, from M11-2, by the server's pgTAP tests, so both apply the same rules. Each case is one route's ascents, oldest first: by the session's local date, then the ascent's ordinal (the server must use the same order, never a client-supplied timestamp). `remove` lists indexes deleted in an edit before checking. `expect` lists the issue keys for each remaining ascent. `next` gives what a new ascent may be after the log.
